note: Attacker-controlled DER bytes enter the fuzzer and are wrapped in the gnutls_datum_t raw.
The DER input is parsed into the pkcs12 structure, including macData with iterations=0 and a GOST (STREEBOG-256) digest algorithm.
MAC verification is invoked on the attacker-controlled pkcs12 structure.
iter is read from the input as 0 (the macData.iterations INTEGER is 0), so the GOST key-derivation path will be reached with iter==0.
The MAC digest algorithm OID 1.2.643.7.1.1.2.2.9 maps to GNUTLS_MAC_STREEBOG_256, a GOST algorithm, enabling the GOST retry path.

note: Because the MAC mismatch and algo is STREEBOG_256, the GOST retry branch is entered with gost_retry set to 1.

note: Nettle's pbkdf2 aborts on 0 iterations, causing the global-buffer-overflow READ 8 reported by ASan (the memory-safety sink).
